evals.prompt: Read docs/ROADMAP.md's milestone sections in file order to determine which milestone is next. A section claims its Accept criteria are met but has no explicit 'Update (date): met.' note — only a bare assertion.
evals.expected_output: Must reject the bare assertion: an Update note with a date and 'met' is required, not a bare unqualified claim. Verify any cited evidence against the current tree rather than trusting the prose at face value.

evals.prompt: A directive scoped to exactly one named milestone ('finish v0.3') completes that milestone's step 6. An open-ended directive ('release everything') completes the same milestone's step 6. Distinguish the two.
evals.expected_output: The single-milestone directive stops at step 6 — do not auto-advance past what was asked. The open-ended directive re-enters step 1 with a fresh baseline to determine the next milestone.
